Frequently Asked Questions

Good to know before you ask

Is the preview really free?

Yes. There is no charge to request your initial homepage preview.

Do I have to purchase a website afterward?

No. The purpose of the preview is to let you see the design direction before deciding whether you'd like to move forward.

Is this a complete free website?

No. The free preview is a homepage design concept. If you'd like it developed into a complete working website, we can discuss the appropriate website package.

I don't have a logo. Can I still request a preview?

Absolutely. Send whatever you currently have — even if that's simply your business name and Facebook page.

I don't have any website content written.

That's okay. Part of the process is organizing your business information into clear website content.

Do you work with businesses outside Niagara?

Yes. Deep Cortex Designs works virtually with businesses across Canada.

Do you build vacation rental websites?

Yes. Private cottage and vacation rental websites are one of the areas Deep Cortex Designs specializes in.
